description: Full profiles for up to 5 suppliers by ref (E1234): self-declared company type, founding year, location and street address (English and Chinese), certificates, staff, export markets, payment terms, listings with prices and MOQs, and on_record: government records about the supplier (FDA registration and 510(k) clearances, US recalls, import declarations naming it as maker), each with its source, date and link. Spends one search.
name: get_suppliers
title: Get supplier profiles
